question: Survival duration, score-context hazards and additive error attribution
finding: Survival and score-context hazards already implemented. Survival reduces starter RMSE 14.7600→11.8991 / 14.6848→11.7979, but combined 2025 overall minute-MAE worsens by .3605 (fixture CI [.3056,.4144]); this is not a reason to optimize MAE blindly.

baseline: Original locked MM and partition-only, logistic and duration arms
